mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active and does not require threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annually), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, which correlates with robust consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1500, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 110, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. This signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. This signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
